patch_description: Replace diameter-based modulation with a narrow displacement threshold while retaining four-particle allocation. The current rule's mean offline error of 3.87 exceeds both supplied constants' errors, motivating a different observable. Use radius multiplier 1.25 when observed best displacement exceeds default_radius, otherwise 1.1875. This tests whether greater observed displacement benefits from modestly broader relocation; its predictive value and performance remain unproven.
